setcode_check: CCG_v1.db inspected for base 12-bit setcodes within packed integer or little-endian BLOB; checked Aldrez 0xc1c, Ursarctic 0x163, Nephthys 0x11f, Hydra 0x124, Krawler 0x104 against Galactica 0x9c9; no intersections. Does not cover changing setcodes, future cards, or other databases.
